scope: Fresh English public-label supplied-paragraph CPU reader profile. Not PDF ingestion, retrieval quality, hosted default inference or a CPU production SLA.

source.license: CC BY-SA 4.0; SQuAD authors and underlying Wikipedia
source.labels: Original public crowdworker answer spans and impossible flags, not independently reviewed here

cohort.model_training_contamination: Unknown; public dev data may occur in pretraining

reader.implementation: Unmodified LocalReader with actual CitedReader assembly, quote validation and draft policy; one complete supplied paragraph as evidence
reader.thinking: Pinned Instruct-2507 non-thinking model; no alternate reader or precision fallback

environment.installation: Fresh hash-locked CPU environment; Python 3.11 or 3.13 only; no unlocked fallback

cohort_sizing: Before inspecting answers, correctness or routing, use pilot timing only. Require at least four completed generations. Cost per question = max(longest attempted question including timeouts, twice the median completed-generation question time). Reserve twice measured total setup and 20 percent of the remaining 19800 seconds. Freeze the largest even cohort at most 200 supported by that cost, taking a balanced prefix of the frozen pool. Below forty cases, do not run final evaluation.
pilot_outcomes: Private raw outputs retained but not inspected for cohort sizing. Pilot questions never enter the final cohort. A feasibility failure does not justify retrying generated failures or quietly changing precision.
metrics: Requested-cohort candidate short-answer EM and token F1 using official answer normalization and max over public references. An impossible example is correct only after explicit valid abstention. Format/runtime failures, invalid auxiliary metric fields and unserved requests are failures in requested-cohort metrics, with categories reported separately. Completed-only metrics and their denominators are separate. Report answerable/unanswerable strata, false abstention, draft/hold counts, token counts, latency and numerical/truncation/format failures.
baselines: Always abstain, evaluated on the same balanced requested cohort
Historical readers reported only as unmatched context-disjoint studies, not paired model superiority
intervals: Nominal 2000 seed-19 question bootstrap and per-stratum descriptive intervals. One question per paragraph does not establish independent articles or a user population.
publication: Numeric records and aggregate metrics only. Raw text, gold spans and model responses stay private and outside Git. Human labels are public reference labels, not new private review. R1-R8 artifacts remain immutable.
release_effect: No default model, gate, language support or deployment behavior changes from this research profile.
